Front_agent.Generate_sum_hit_and_run: Generates a composition design space based on given elements (solvents), their respective minimum and maximum (percentages). Should be used when there are too many samples for generate_space_sum.
Front_agent.Generate_space_sum: Generates a composition design space based on given elements (solvents), their respective minimum and maximum (percentages), and their respective number of steps. Returns two lists representing each feasible combinations of solvents and their respective mass percentages.
Front_agent.Generate_space_grid: Generates a composition design space based on given elements (salts), their respective minimum and maximum (molality), and their respective number of steps. Returns two lists representing each feasible combinations of salts and their respective molalities.
Front_agent.Generate_compositionID: Generate a list of experimentID with a 2d-array with given solvents and salts, and another 2d-array with their corresponding mass percentage or molality, and save them into a JSON file. Parameter 'repeat=n' means to repeat each identical experiments n times. By default, repeat=2, indicating each experiments to be runned twice. Also be aware of the necessity of experiment components (density, conductivity, and viscosity). Set the parameters to True if you need to measure them, and false otherwise.
Front_agent.Verify_CompositionID: Verifies whether all the given ID in the list is correct. If all the IDs are correct, it will then check whether all experiments are feasible. The feasible experiments be saved into a JSON file, and the infeasible experiments will be returned as a list.
Front_agent.Start_experiment: Queue the experiments with a given file path. Do not use this when you try to continue the experiment.
Front_agent.Continue_experiment: Use this function when you are told errors are resolved to continue running the experiments.
Front_agent.Get_experiment_progress: Use this tool whenever the user asks about experiment progress, status, or queue. It returns the current state of experiments.

Experiment_agent.generate_procedure: Use the passed in experimentID to call this method to generate and perform the procedure. If the procedure ends correctly, you will receive a message with 'No errors'.
